content: Kielien Asazho
Ersa Mexihade shitu danlasan BeduruBendu, Jialatai, Jiapadojia, Yaxiya, Bituinide sandazhi zhanshi jiere souzhi Huda sunghusan kunlade xin huaizho.
Ada Huda tai eqighanse jinjidene Shenlinghala zhiguishigha Ersa Mexihai shunjighazhi hhei chusunghala xireighazhi ganjinraghawo. Huda tande nenjien, pinnan olon ogi gie!
Mai Ezhan Ersa Mexihai ada Hudade doulaye! Hhe matande hende ubali xiidene Ersa Mexihai fugusan kun dundase aminne olughakughala matanyi erchan olughazhi zhenzhenji xiwon ogizho.
Pse ulie xiuqiraku, ulie zannantuku, ulie widaku jiachanyi tande oluzhi asiman jiere sunjizho.
Huda ta xianxin giekui tungo giezhi nenlighalane tai baohu giedene duya barakude xienjizhi khizhene giesan jiuikui tande ogine.
Ingiese ta hende bayasuzho. Ta bixi zhanshi jiere yanyanji kunnande yuchou giezhoma,
enezighan kunnan tai xinyanshi zhenni bikui mejieghane. Khande tuliesan antanliuzhe huailunema, tai xinyan antanse da guizhunde Ersa Mexiha xienjikude tande kuaiku, fama, zhiguii ireghane.
Ta Ersai chanlazhi ese daozhoma, hhende orezho. Edeliuzhe hhei chanla danema, hhei xianxin giezhi kielienghala kielie daku, hashu witu bayasukughala bayasuzho.
Ta xinyanni jiegoi jienliezho. Hheshi goyane jiuiku wo.
Ene jiuikui kieliese xienzhila xianxide chaizhi yenjiu giezhi daozho. Tande ogine giesan ene nenjienni hhela melie kieliezhi daozho.
Hhela Mexihashi kien bikui, yan xienzide irekui yenjiu giezho. Mexiha shouku giedene khuinashi fama irekui Mexihani ruhher hhelai sudoro melie kieliezho.

Hhela ene wiliei giese goyadene ese giezho, tande oluzhi giesei Huda hhelade mejieghazho. Ene gouxioxishi chonjichen kunla asiman jierese peizhi ireghasan Shenlinyi nenlighala ede tande chonjizhi ogiwo. Ene shiqinlai qienxienlaye hende uzheku duran wo.
Zhiguide Udu Daoku
Ingiese ta zhughedene zhunbei giezhi jinxin giedene Ersa Mexiha xienjikude tande deilazhi ireku nenjienyi goude panji.
Ta shunjiku kewosi danlazhi eqighanku mutun yama mejie dazhi nefuxin giekulai bu dagha.
Tai urusan Hudashi zhigui mutun taye yan shiqin giese zhiguide gie.
Jinwun jiere jilazhi kieliezho, "Bishi zhiguitu wo, taye zhiguishi."
Ta xiahua giekude kunni pienxin ulie giezhi kunni giekughala panjichen Ezhanni Ada giezhi uruse ta zhanshi jiere duyade bikude hhei zunjizhi udu dao.
Ta mejiene. Tai xienrenla tande chonjizhi ogisan yama zoin witu xigonse tai shuisanshi huailuku antan, miengughala pusho,
Mexihani zhiguitu chusunghala wo. Hoxian goujida uye chaizhi ese cheiqisan ghoni ghughanyi chusunyi xianli.
Huda Mexihai duya zhayaghaku melie jinjiwoma, duya barakude tande oluzhi xienjizhi khizheghawo.
Ta Mexihai tungo giezhi hhei fugusan kun dundase aminne olughazhi hhende kuaikui ogisan Hudai xianxin giezho. Ingiese ta xianxin giesan, panjisanne man Hudade kouizho.
Ta zhendaoi shunjizhi goyane ganjinraghazhi kunlade zhenzhenji orezho. Ingiese xiacha giezhi zhughesene nieniedene orendu.
Tai erchan olusanshi huailuku fureghala pusho, ulie huailuku fureghala wo. Hudai chanqi ulie widaku, amitu kielienghala wo.
Jinwun jiere kieliezho,

content.text: Kunni fama osun jieredu chizhe niekielien wo.

content: Ene kielienshi tande chonjisan gouxioxi wo.
